<code_changes_summary>
Profiled and documented evaluation mechanics, data distributions, coverage axes, and runtime. Implemented training-only categorical vocabularies, feature exclusions, and the deterministic three-seed native-categorical XGBoost model. The initial XGBoost/CatBoost blend scored 0.8491, triggering the prescribed pure-XGBoost fallback, which scored 0.8490 while preserving the required output contract.

<technical_difficulties>
The initial XGBoost probe failed with `TypeError: Category index must contain only values of the same type ... boolean`; converting boolean categorical values to strings before constructing training-derived categorical dtypes fixed it. A profiling script raised `ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'C000001'` because customer IDs are strings, so subsequent profiling preserved them as strings. A compound delete/add patch targeting `predict.py` twice was rejected; replacing it with one update patch succeeded. The specified ensemble scored 0.8491, narrowly below the 0.85 target; its predeclared pure-XGBoost fallback scored 0.8490, and no third private-score experiment was used.
</technical_difficulties>
